page.overview:
Who is Ankorodō Shop Owner?

This woman is the owner of the Ankorodō shop in Konohagakure.

She was a kunoichi many years in the past. During a previous eating contest, she also offered unlimited free sweet sake to the winner, a prize won by Chōji Akimichi. She nearly went bankrupt providing free sake to Chōji, making the shop owner determined to never again risk her restaurant's welfare with an "unlimited" offer.

She is very worried about her business and does not want to lose it, which is why she hates Chōji Akimichi, who once almost ruined her. She is a cunning woman and is ready to do anything to prevent Chōji from winning the glutton contest by going to various tricks. She is also a little forgetful, as she could not remember how to undo the technique she had created. After the fraud in the competition was revealed, the old woman was very shocked, but nevertheless repented of her deeds and, apparently, gave Chōji and his daughter a well-deserved prize. Sai noted that this punishment is much worse than being in prison.

She is a short, elderly woman with grey hair and sunken eyes, which are nonetheless visible in moments of extreme arousal. She has only three teeth in her mouth, and there are many birthmarks on her wrinkled face. She wears a brown striped robe over which is tied a light-coloured apron depicting a leaf and three small circles on the upper left side. In addition, she wears simple sandals, and her hair is tied in a bun and covered with a blanket.
